headings: Two computers that end up the same
assessment: Read preamble and The point through the check/use discussion. Strong concrete reasoning already: two sorting machines, warehouse lamps, forged trace, recorder loop, fingerprint capacity, copier rechecking, clerk/sticky note, wrong-pocket Gettier and versioned memory. Keep organization and examples; they already give actions, counterexamples and scope. One overstatement converts plausible computational depth into an actual historical event; narrow it so the example does not promise evidence it cannot supply.

headings: Settled, whether it's true or not
Computing already had a word for it
assessment: Read the counterfactual checker, Peirce/Popper, creating subject, rejected analogies, Kepler/Kempe, Flatland and start of COMMIT. The defective-output intervention, barn contrast, recorder undoing, reset thermometer and chess rights provide real tests of distinctions; keep. The group-judgment result arrives only as authority: add a three-ballot exercise. Correct the leap from a check that could fail to an irreversible record: nontriviality does not create permanence, and changing confidence in a proof is not the same observable as a retained record of a completed act.

headings: Somebody got there first, goddamn it
The two computers, put back together
What putting it in the step buys
assessment: Read reference monitors, the one-way room, chair proof, Landauer qualification, Rovelli comparison, model definition, side-by-side sorter/copier trace and scope of every program. The run table and refusals already expose the mechanism; preserve. Repair two observable ambiguities: the chair exercise models alternative starts, not literal loss of the identities of visible people; a universal yes-check can certify a true tautology, so it is not automatically wrong. Qualify the heat parenthesis so chairs do not masquerade as a physical heat measurement.

headings: What's proved, what's argued, and what I just believe
At the bottom: what I suspect and can't prove
Before the book: the short version
assessment: Read remaining introduction, physical suspicion, short version and five-step roadmap. Existing contrast of record/base/checker and the sorted-list trace already gives operational meaning; the coin/chalk/copies picture is explicitly conjectural and challenged by Bell, so do not pretend it is an experiment performed. The entitlement summary is the first genuinely opaque counting passage: give eight-to-two numbered cards and explicitly separate identification questions from ledger charges. Keep the overview as an overview rather than append a demonstration to every listed result.

headings: Let me be straight with you
assessment: Read all fine print, layer distinctions, Ariane overflow example, prior-work comparison table and every neighbor item. This is explicitly a reference/map section, not a first derivation; adding props to each attribution would obscure it. The Ariane case makes bounded implementation concrete, and the three pricing senses connect to the existing run table. One layer sentence incorrectly sounds as though the unbounded small machine inherits the finite-state derivation; narrow it to its own prices and earned-rule guarantee.

headings: A string, a square, and a drowning nobody can place
Prove it from what you and I both accept
assessment: Read lunch etymology, entire origin narrative, strings and diagonal, Plato, Euclid and statue/sandwich. Preserve personal authorship and method; the enacted diagonal and material substitution are the book’s target voice. The string needs a controllable tension condition so an actual rubber-band trial does not fail for an unstated physical reason. Replace a couple of odd-square trials with the dot-pairing reason valid for every odd square. Make the third-man regress conditional on treating the property as another instance, instead of saying it works for every property unconditionally.

headings: Naming a thing by saying when two are the same
Choose the changes, keep what survives
An invariance comes with a bill
A set with some named relations
The structure is in the arrows
Structure is the part that compresses
The four parts of every computer
assessment: Read relations/topology, Frege/Russell, invariance, Noether, structuralism, category definition, full MDL toy code, Turing and start of seven-part overlay. Many excellent actions already: room description, square transformations, literal code costs and changing the code. Keep the Noether paragraph as credited motivation with its unproved calculus scope explicit; the book does not depend on it. Clarify intrinsic drawn connections versus new contacts caused by crumpling; add a triangle operation to associativity; soften coin-flip claims because one comparison does not exhaust all blocks and randomness can produce a short pattern by chance.

headings: A demon, and the step that pays
assessment: Read complete seven-part overlay, equivalence/partition proof, buckets and index caveat, clay/witnesses, double-entry manipulation, Maxwell/Bennett and short related-cost lineage. The partition proof is grounded before its symbols and the ledger tampering exercise already has an adversarial second trial; keep. A cookie tin alone does not reproduce a sealed clay ball: specify the seal and its limitations. The checksum invitation lacks a rule and could imply cryptographic security; supply a five-entry arithmetic trial, keep a comparison copy, and demonstrate compensating edits. Qualify the repeated heat statement by uncertainty and thermal assumptions.

headings: What they all agree on, and who they rule out
The smallest thing that could carry the bill
What this does and doesn't buy
A closed room with no spare chair
assessment: Read all. The two-box game, arbitrary pricing, first-crossing proof, vacuity, repeated raises, and two-flag composition already supply executable reasoning. Keep structure. Clarify that chair positions encode alternative starts: watching named people retains information outside the reported state. Qualify recurrence assumptions and the Enron rhetorical overstatement.

headings: Now charge for forgetting, and the toll falls out
Door one: keep everything, and nothing ever has to merge
Door two: let the flag come back down
How much: the price grows with the squeeze
assessment: Read all. Three escape doors, endless strip cut to eight, coin flip, three-card merge/revoke, proof of forced pricing, and squeeze provide clear operational constructions. Repair paper stamp examples: physically distinct sheets are not identical states merely because all are stamped. Separate logical reading/reset from whole physical object and avoid treating transfer into any environment as necessarily heat. Historical attribution passages need no invented demonstration.

headings: The same bill, written in bits, and when it's zero
What you're entitled to, and what you're not
assessment: Read all. Squeeze proof and entropy proof are self-contained, but weighted entropy loss benefits from one explicit distribution a reader can sort by hand. Keep existing coin/cup comparison and four-state collision counterexample; correct fair-coin setup and wording that mistakes no demanded heat for achievable zero. Update four-card reference after preceding repair. The theorem statements remain unchanged.

headings: Learning is free, committing is not
A small being at a small door
The demon on a sheet of paper
assessment: Read all. Record-layer proof names exact colliding states; single-orbit and externally scheduled counterexamples are operational. The long stochastic relaxation passage becomes too abstract: add a ten-counter draw with replacement showing long-run chance, stretch length and mass/flow, explicitly a stochastic illustration rather than a calorimeter. Distinguish total entropy production from heat, and detailed balance from merely local detailed balance. Bennett demon and four-dot MEASURE/WIPE section already show the work; retain.

headings: Who holds the pen changes the bill
The smallest machine that teaches for free, and the one that can't
What the toll prices, said at last
A stick, split down the middle
Conservation: the total is the charges and nothing else
assessment: Read all. Free-teacher three-state ring and two-state impossibility, conservation, induction uniqueness and Lamport notes already give hand-checkable reasoning. Repair conditional erasure example: looking at a card then rubbing out a note does not demonstrate a reversible rule. Use red/blue card with blank/marked note and a specified toggle. Tally halves detect disagreement but do not identify which holder cheated; restrict card demo against trimming/replacement. No wholesale renaming of honest here; these uses concern accurate accounting, not base-driven constraints.

headings: The toll is an old trick with a new name
What the counter is, said once
A cave, and the people who got good at it
The whole fact, in one paragraph
People who found this on their own
assessment: Read all. Fold/descent one-bit counterexample, potential coin stack, flag four-case proof, hidden counter, and four possible decoders already tie abstract terms to actions. Lamp experiment needs projection conditions: ordinary point-source perspective is not exact parallel projection. Repeated looks may teach (three-state ring); the no-information statement must apply to whole observation histories, not every repeated use of a fixed window. Keep historical comparisons as comparisons.

headings: The three escapes, and what each one costs
assessment: Read all. Notes across room, distributed desks/slips, clerk before/after photos, two runs with same transcript, three concrete escapes, and coin-selected cave protocol all meet tangible standard. Repair abstract-interpretation analogy: sound approximation is not exact fibre constancy; an interval example makes distinction visible. Restrict maximum/minimum price discussion to attained bounded charges (rise indicator), since arbitrary natural costs need not have a maximum over a fibre. Preserve comparisons and three trust contracts.

Read all. Transcript relations are immediately grounded in A/B runs, counter values, photographs and explicit truth contracts; proof is complete on page. Coin replacement under cups, changed versus mistaken belief, edition count, and three-column comparison make entitlement operational. Retain all. Philosophical classifications remain author interpretation, and toy commitments are expressly not adversarial cryptography. No new prop or prose needed in this chunk.

headings: What narrowing costs: count the rivals
When the run does the narrowing
assessment: Read all. Comparison cards, coin cups, tests on six permutations, list/duplicate caveat, first-crossing count and 16-to-1 counterexample explain the narrowing assumptions concretely. Fix twenty-questions shorthand: an individual lucky answer can remove more than half; halving is worst-case balanced capacity. Add one physical grouping/refinement trial immediately before bucket theorem so keys, partitions and refinement are visible objects rather than names alone.

headings: What happens when a computation learns
Test, then commit, and nothing forces the second to follow the first
Records over any base: the latch
assessment: Read all. Psychological examples, explicit four-move board, Popper protocol, and cup latch establish operational meaning without pretending psychology proves ledger results. Keep voice and history. Clarify cup/die trial can contain no six and is stochastic whereas theorem base is deterministic: record rolls first and replay tape; event reads next fixed entry. Latch proof is two-case argument on page, and reversible-history proof identifies what is retained.

headings: Both rules do work: the toggle and the clock
Is there only one such machine? No. One structure, two free choices.
Bases from outside, and a relation I have to be honest about
assessment: Read all. Clean-start cup, paired revocation cups, toggle, surcharges, independent event selection and weighted probabilistic bit all give tangible counterexamples. Repair hidden-clock demonstration: a fixed seventh replay entry is base-driven if position is in base; demonstrate two hidden clock offsets at identical base and off cup instead, matching formal lemma. Remove stale promise of checked source names in book. Historical/past-hypothesis comparisons are explicitly author interpretations, not proofs.

headings: Records with more than two values
What the base being free buys you
The toll, over the whole direction
Why crossing a line has to cost
The ordinary machine is a shadow
assessment: Read all. Record direction is already developed in cups, diamond, preorder swap, fixed-join failure and three escape machines; retain these. Replace ascending proof-tool-status example with concrete manuscript/workflow stages and independent routes: machine-checking must not stand as the summit of truth. Add a three-box indirect addressing trial and exact coarse/fine step example, since operational tables and weak relation otherwise arrive without working them once.

headings: How much gets destroyed, on average
The same move, again and again
Four things it doesn't give you
Now point it at the record
assessment: Read all. Parity window, first-cup collision, fibre merge and diagonal cards are effective constructions. Correct claim that cross-fibre merge means record loses nothing (both can lose distinctions). Infinite-pile theorem lacks its short supporting calculation: add coin-toss construction for geometric spread and explicit telescoping/block-growth argument, thereby explaining rather than invoking entropy arithmetic. Historical diagonal family explicitly separates theorem boundaries; keep.

headings: What this does to the book
Proof-of-stake finality: the price is on going back
assessment: Read all. Generic diagonal proof is complete with explicit witnesses; nat-family outside decider is walked in all cases. Lambda definitions and fixed-point construction need a small substitution rehearsal, not repository evidence: add paper identity, self-application and de Bruijn bound-variable example. Casper three-validator experiment needs both justification and finalization links to truly finalize branches; spell those out. Preserve exact theorem claims and narrow shortcut scope.

headings: Gas: the one that charges a fee at the write
Attestation: hash chains, and a quote about the past
Proof-carrying code: no price, no permanence
assessment: Read all. Gas arithmetic, rollback examples, quote collision, memory limit and recipe/kitchen comparison work, but two definitions still defer essential operational rules to external specifications: storage refund changes and Merkle verifier left/right control. Read implementations to recover exactly modeled rules, then supply complete prose rules and the seven-card tree/path walk in book. Preserve scope (one slot; symbolic hashes; no security proof) and make gas invariant cases explicit.

headings: Where the shape comes from, and how much of it survived
What isn't checked, and must stay that way on the page
assessment: Read all. Pointer thesis fairly distinguishes mapping claims from evidence, but observer independence needs a manipulable two-card trial; add it. Twelve-row survey names models without specifying their maps: write the shared construction and blind-observer variant so each result is reproducible within book. Repair summary calling every surveyed record one-way despite PCC and reset limits. Remove stray file-authority and revision-status wording; preserve thesis, comparisons and falsification directions.

headings: What the model actually asks for
assessment: Read all. Two bins of pebbles, tag-game traces, state inventory, six-instruction table, A=4 version failure and oldest-fact consensus protocol already put the machine on the table. Retain; later exact statements need inspection for shared-memory proof completeness. Correct earlier sentence denying any previous argument reaches this machine: whole-state finite theorem does not, but book has already proved record-layer merge toll under its explicit premise. No extra illustrative clutter needed.

headings: It computes everything two counters can
It's a certification system, and the flag is a latch
assessment: Read all. Exact definitions, three-step successful and failed runs, parity proof, instruction-by-instruction simulation, untouched version reasoning, historical versus current certification and no-forgery invariant all explain mechanisms. No new example necessary. Make two terminology repairs: mathematical components instead of software data fields; base-driven as the already-defined latch condition. Preserve meaningful warning that passed property, successful CHECK, and certificate are separate events.

headings: The window can't see the record
What it takes to be Thiele-complete
assessment: Read all. Full-table invariant, two explicit traces with same window, probe COMMIT, three-link minimum, plain-versus-fixed-language definition and four single-clause counterexamples are already concrete. Correct summary of window-price theorem to require collision between steps, not merely indistinguishable states. Clarify table keeps checked facts rather than full run history and exact-three attainability applies to loaded starts (trapped starts cannot certify). Unit scaling proof is arithmetic on ledger and prices; retain.

headings: One machine that runs them all
Every computably presented Thiele machine, on one host: driven, decided, priced in whole units, carried as a latch
assessment: Read all. Definition instances, universal-window construction, host program narrative and finite-property pigeonhole are detailed and on-page. Add one numerical slot/mirror rehearsal showing how 18 packages evenness of 4 and how INC/DEC changes version while leaving value fixed. Clarify combined host table capacity when per-counter k is below sixteen. Correct halting reduction map from identity to the expressly defined loading map. Preserve full U inventory and defer line-level block review to appendix.

headings: A simpler host, with the guest step built in
The machine versus the program it runs
Parts II and III, run on this machine
assessment: Read all. Presented-host evaluator and surcharge need short actual runs to ground fuel and max(c,3); add fuel0/fuel1 counter routine and prices1,1,1 comparison. Simpler built-in host has explicit three-step paid and trapped traces, bank/game metaphor, and loop; keep. Narrow statement that simulation-exact host must avoid a primitive guest step: impossibility applies to this one fixed-price GSTEP move, not every host design. Eight-state compilation is already an instruction recipe.

headings: The diagonal, on this machine's programs
assessment: Read all. Eight-state macro cases and explicit free DEC collision, two narrowing examples (8 to 2 and 16 to 1), bit search, and threshold-time ladder supply concrete witnesses. General entitlement hypotheses are explained as bookkeeping checklist with unused clauses disclosed. Fix unqualified summary suggesting every narrowing run pays its index bits; free learning counterexample remains valid. Weighted sums should not be called expectations without normalization. Host Rice and specialization give actual compilation recipes; continue following construction.

headings: What the universal machine covers, and what it doesn't
What this chapter adds up to
assessment: Read the entire chunk. Retain host self-reference, input factor and explicit two-history counterexample. Correct replay allowance versus actual COMMIT count, add numeric factor preservation, clarify U versus UP start conditions and logical versus physical toll. The compressed no-plain-recursion stage argument needs expansion from its mathematical construction; source stage/chain lemmas inspected and the finite-control, forced-run, transfer-stage and coprime-product argument now supplied in full.

headings: The same thing, in seven models
assessment: Read entire chunk. Box/panel, five-lever macro, shared writer, handoff and nesting examples are concrete and retained. Fix false statement that levers never touch panel (they raise tally); supply full one-counter finite bound proof; explain coherence by following labelled wires. Lift theorem and composition hypotheses remain explicit; no structural reorganisation.

headings: A second machine, written by hand, to check the first
From source programs to the host
Where it came from, and why anyone cared
Five sentences that are easy to say by accident
The five-by-five, and what positive semidefinite means
assessment: Read entire chunk. Executable limitations, unary slowdown, four-bit CHSH plan, finite tally limitation and numerical PSD trials already operational; retained. Add setting independence explicitly and narrow PR-box claim from relativity in full to no-signalling. Historical anecdotes are attribution, not proof of mathematical or physical claims; no external fact-check claimed.

headings: The check, earned on the host machine
A rational stand-in for an irrational number
The calibration is a unit conversion
assessment: Read full chunk, recovering omitted middle of initial tool output separately. Integer CHSH seven facts, five test tallies, packed property, tolerance and guarantee limits are unusually concrete. Retain main constructions and defer full math inspection to appendix. Qualify fair-coin simulation observation; remove filename-based physics framing. Tolerance now states it is wired into fixed-property CHECK in this manuscript, unlike old merged-PR handoff; verification must respect current state.

headings: The premises have to be able to hold together
The calorimeter protocol, as a specification
What permanence adds to Landauer: nothing new, said plainly
The abstract claims (Parts II and III)
assessment: Read entire chunk. Calibration versus empirical bridge, structural price premise versus actual entropy loss, history lift, canonical toy limitations and falsifier instructions retained. Add explicit driven step separating work, heat and retained energy; correct SI measurement wording and remove unseen-file pointer. No claim that the device experiment has been performed.

Read entire chunk, recovering the omitted entitlement and latch rows separately. Ledger is a reference index, not a place to add more demonstrations. Reconcile Casper summary with two-link example; remove vendored-library framing. All home-reference and condition distinctions retained. Missing ledger coverage of lift/composition/run chapters will be added without moving existing entries.

Read entire chunk. Scope and conclusion preserve the author's argument and distinguish proposals from mathematical guarantees. Correct obsolete denial of operator realisations: appendix constructs them for correlators, not full prescribed marginals. No new repetitive objects or restatement of revision history added.

headings: Things I had to learn first
Bits, bytes, and what a CPU sees
The notation the formal parts use
Other terms I use without rebuilding
Borrowed ideas the book pushes on
assessment: Read entire chunk: conclusion end, full glossary, assumptions and start attribution. Existing binary pencil demonstration, categorical natural/integer examples, Schur counterexample and witness examples retained. Fix outdated tensor-notation denial and incorrect general CPU-trap definition. Assumptions remain mathematical conditions, not zero-axiom marketing.

headings: The universal floor and the potential method
The toll from finiteness, permanence, and a price on merges
Windows that can't price what they hide
The record axis is a latch
Thiele-complete, defined so a clock fails
assessment: Read entire attribution section and start CHSH derivation. Attribution is retained as attribution, with novelty claims scoped to author searches rather than certification. Detailed factorization and deterministic-plan argument stand on their own. No added demonstration needed in credit paragraphs.

Read entire chunk. Six-square identity, explicit Schur test vectors, seven-integer denominator clearing, rational examples, nine-by-nine residual and exact cascade provide reconstructible arithmetic. Retain mathematics and working examples. Found alphabetic item cross-references with no corresponding printed item labels; replace by actual subsection references.

headings: The arcsine boundary, in both directions
The finite local model, in both directions
Recursion without running under a lambda
Finite programs made from two instructions
A tape in finitely many counters
Packing finitely many counters into two
assessment: Read entire chunk. Pencil-shadow/Gram, signed-card anticommutation, quantum bench distinction, hinge intervals and card distributions retained with full derivations. Add a concrete description-of-description introduction to quoting, which otherwise opens entirely symbolically. Counter/tape/prime constructions already tangible and explicit.

headings: Seven descriptions of the same computation
Why the blocks simulate a guest
assessment: Read entire chunk and recovered omitted head-block lines separately. Prime input encodings, halting card, FRACTRAN numeric trial, delayed folded branches, budget search, complete U/UP block listings and version trial retained. Methodology is one modest paragraph, no Coq-dependent argument. Bibliography opening read; sources are credits, not substitutes for mathematical construction.
